visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with extreme close-up shots of various gourmet items, including a circular yellow butter pat embossed with a flower logo on a white ceramic plate and a plastic-wrapped sugar cube inside a bowl. These are followed by shots of stacked sandwiches and translucent dumplings, all featuring the same floral motif. (2) A man with short black hair and a black sweater appears, standing in a grand, circular room lined with towering wooden bookshelves. He holds a smartphone on a gimbal, filming himself and the surroundings. The lighting is bright and diffuse, highlighting the luxurious interior design. (3) The footage cuts to the exterior of a multi-story building with a modern glass and white facade featuring the Louis Vuitton logo. Inside, the ceiling is adorned with thousands of pink and white floral decorations hanging downwards. (4) The man is shown exploring the cafe, pointing at displays of books and iconic monogrammed trunks. He then sits down to eat, showing the process of pouring sauce over dumplings and taking a bite of a sandwich. Red and white variety show captions appear frequently on the screen.
